text:
Apparently, there’s a glitch that lets you run GTA 6 at 60 FPS on Xbox Series X:
- Go to Settings → General → TV & display options → Refresh rate → 60Hz
- Launch GTA 6 and wait for the 6 stars to appear in the intro
- Go back to Settings and switch the refresh rate to 120Hz
- Open a different game via the Xbox Guide (don't close GTA 6)
- Switch back to GTA 6 using Quick Resume

author: uzonna7
text:
My son swallowed.

Apparently, the buyer had gone through his old GTA Online conversations.

Son: "Dad, someone has been logging into my GTA Online account for three years."

I leaned closer.

Me: "What do you mean?"

Son: "They've been sending messages to people, pretending to be me."

I felt uncomfortable.

Me: "Who?"

He didn't answer immediately.

Instead, he turned the laptop around and showed me dozens of conversations.

Then he pointed at one username.

Son: "Dad, look at this."

I recognized it immediately.

It belonged to my younger brother.
